candidate_reports.remark: A member of the public reported a waterspout that had occurred around 5:19 PM EST via social media. The waterspout was associated with a cloud line_ and occurred to the southwest of Higgs Beach. The photo with the report showed a very skinny condensation funnel that extended approximately 1/4 of the way to the surface from the cloud base at a 45-degree angle. There was no spray ring visible. The waterspout was reported to have lasted a few minutes.
candidate_reports.ugc_name: Hawk Channel from west end of Seven Mile Bridge to Halfmoon Shoal out to the reef

candidate_reports.remark: A member of the public reported a pair of waterspouts that occurred around 2:30 PM EST via social media. The waterspouts were associated with a shower that formed along a line northeast of Big Pine Key. The photos included with the report showed very skinny condensation funnels that extended from the cloud base to the lowest visible elevation at a near 90 degree angle. Buildings obstructed the view of the surface of the water_ and no spray rings were visible with either waterspout. The waterspout was reported to have lasted a few minutes.
